desc: Late-night rain on glass under a sparse felt piano, Fmaj7-Am7-Dm9-Bbmaj7, 62 bpm, 1-3 notes a bar, a melody fragment every 4th bar, soft pad, long reverb. thinFrom/thinTo = piano drops to single notes; resolveAt = one warm full chord. Low end trimmed for phone speakers (bassGain .6, pad an octave up, room .02).
